name: Phanerochaete velutina

tip_speed.note: from a search snippet (8.4 mm/day); the paper was not opened

growth_unit.note: no measurement for this species; fast-explorer value suggested in research/01 section 4

branch_angle.note: no measurement for this species; fast-explorer value suggested in research/01 section 4

branch_angle_sd.note: default from Hopkins & Boswell 2012 (79 +/- 10 deg, research/09); not measured for this species

sensitivity.note: how strongly tips turn away from crowding; model coefficient

fusion_probability.note: fitted so that the engine gives about 1 fusion per 8 branches, as measured in Podospora anserina (research/01 [8]); not measured for this species

density_cap.note: hyphal density at which branching stops; tuning value

cord_max.note: largest cord cross-section, in single hyphae; cords of 48 to 480 um are measured (research/02) but this is a tuning value

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found

degradation_rate.note: none seen in 15 h in R. solani; small value so dead hyphae clear

passive_transport.note: diffusion between neighbouring segments; measured diffusion inside hyphae (1 to 2 x 10^-9 m2/s, research/10) is several times faster than the passes allow

soil.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

wood.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

litter.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

root.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

agar.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

transport_speed.note: solute velocity in cords 20 to 100 mm/h, rising with cord development; the low end is used

t_opt.note: extension rises with temperature from 5 to 20 or 27 C (research/08 [14])

wobble.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

avoidance.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

fusion_probability.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

uptake.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

turn.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

ecology.substrate: fallen broadleaf wood; grows through soil between pieces

notes: Extension is roughly linear in time and rises with temperature from 5 to 20 or 27 C [14]; smaller inocula and grazing by soil animals slow it [15]. Reported (unchecked) to be the best-measured foraging network of any fungus (Boddy and Fricker groups).
